summary: Graphene Solar Technologies (OTCQB: GSTX) furnished an 8-K on September 25, 2026, reporting a September 21, 2026 press release that its US manufacturing subsidiary, The Quartz Silicon Materials Company Limited, received approval from California's CAEATFA for a Sales and Use Tax Exclusion of up to $14,999,831, covering up to $176,468,600 in qualified property for planned California silicon wafer manufacturing. No securities transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. The benefit is contingent on executing the Regulatory Agreement and continued compliance, with realized value dependent on actual qualifying purchases. Routine incentive disclosure; no deal terms or risk-arb angle arise.
